posts.cooked:
EvanDan55:

I will hopefully be there. I was recently offered a paid position on a film set in Louisville that may overlap with Gen Con. If I am accepted onto the set and it overlaps with Gen Con, I will not be able to attend. Best case scenario, I can do both. I'll let the important parties know once I have a final answer.

If you get the position, allow me to offer a few pieces of advice (though you may not need it)

  1. C-47's. If someone asks you to get them C-47's, they mean clothes pins. If its your first time on a set, someone will do this to you, and usually in front of all the electricians and gaffers to have a good laugh.

  2. Even if its not your job, carry 2 rolls of gaff tape with you at all times. One black and one orange or green or something. Someone at somepoint will be very glad you did.

  3. Be nice to the sound guy. No one else will be.
